question: Which kalā is worshipped first before proceeding to Puruṣa in this sequence?
premises: The kalā of Īśāna is the object of worship.
The action iṣṭvā indicates it is done first.
The verse then turns to Puruṣa.
inference: The practitioner first worships the kalā of Īśāna before proceeding to Puruṣa.
uncertainties: The exact sense of manu-asre in this ritual step is unclear.
plain_english: Having worshipped the kalā of Īśāna in the mantra-weapon, one then proceeds to that of Puruṣa.
